nextStoryContext: US-002 repaired the live CHANGELOG.md: restored the intro prose sentence (it previously ended mid-sentence with a dangling '## [Unreleased]' fragment that the old indexOf-based roll had swallowed), inserted a fresh empty '## [Unreleased]' heading directly above '## [0.68.0] - 2026-07-06', and deleted the stale bottom '## [Unreleased]' section (already-shipped CAM-33 push-verification bullets and the CAM-22/CAM-29 stop-hook-retirement bullet) that had sat below '## [0.2.0]' unnoticed. Added test/release/changelog-hygiene.test.ts (4 assertions: exactly one line-anchored heading, heading precedes the first versioned heading, no stale heading after any versioned heading, intro prose line no longer dangling) as a permanent regression guard so a future `cam ship --bump` roll (US-001's line-anchored rollChangelog) cannot silently re-corrupt the live file. All 2 userStories in this PRD now pass; no further implementer work is queued here unless a new story is planned.
